message:
The `get_unaligned_be16` and `get_unaligned_be32` are in `zlib_decompress.c`. The vulnerability is in the `libdeflate_zlib_decompress_ex` function. Let me look at the `deflate_decompress.c` to understand how the decompression works and where the out-of-bounds read could occur.

Let me look at the `libdeflate_deflate_decompress_ex` function and the `decompress_template.h`:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<｜｜DSML｜｜=command>grep -n "libdeflate_deflate_decompress_ex\|actual_in_nbytes" /tmp/libdeflate-1.18/lib/deflate_decompress.c | head -30</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
